JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION A:
Darnell Williams
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0111 | darnell.williams@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Analyst with twelve years of experience building forecasts, dashboards and research briefs for executive teams in public education and community health. Writes SQL and R daily, publishes in Tableau, and spends as much care on the written explanation as on the model behind it. Ready to apply that rigor to retail sales, pricing and inventory questions.

EXPERIENCE
Data Analyst | Alder Street Health Partners, Columbus, OH | Jul 2020 to Present
• Analyst on a two person team for a nonprofit network of 11 community health clinics serving about 68,000 active patients, reporting to the chief operating officer.
• Built the executive operations dashboard in Tableau (visits, no-show rate, provider productivity, payer mix, days in accounts receivable), refreshed nightly from a SQL Server warehouse fed by the electronic health record.
• Pulled no-show rates for a text message appointment reminder pilot at four clinics and four comparison clinics, and charted the results for the operations director.
• Forecast monthly visit volume by clinic and service line in R for provider scheduling and the annual budget.
• Reported duplicate patient records that were inflating panel sizes and helped the data team check the corrected counts.
• Keep the team's shared SQL style guide and code repository organized, and review the second analyst's queries before new reports go to clinic managers.
• Write a one page monthly operations brief for the board finance committee, translating clinic trends into two or three decisions for the coming month.
• Worked with the revenue cycle team to trace a 9 day jump in days in accounts receivable to a payer file format change, then built a daily check on claim file record counts.

Research Analyst | Glenmoor City Schools, Columbus, OH | Aug 2014 to Jun 2020
• Produced the district's five-year enrollment forecast for 31 buildings using cohort survival ratios, housing permit data and kindergarten registration trends. The forecast was one input to facilities planning and a boundary change.
• Built the first Tableau dashboards for the superintendent's cabinet covering attendance, course enrollment and staffing ratios, replacing a quarterly binder of printed tables.
• Wrote SQL against the student information system and state reporting extracts to answer 15 to 25 ad hoc requests a month from principals and central office staff.
• Assessed a reading intervention program with a matched comparison design and presented the results, limitations included, to the school board.
• Prepared the annual staffing ratio tables for the budget office from human resources extracts.
• Fixed recurring errors in building and course codes that caused mismatches between district and state attendance figures.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2014

SKILLS
Languages: SQL (SQL Server, PostgreSQL), R (tidyverse, fable, MatchIt, R Markdown)
Visualization: Tableau Desktop and Server, ggplot2, Excel (pivot tables, Power Query)
Methods: time series forecasting, regression, matched comparisons, survey weighting
Practices: Git, code review, data dictionaries, short written research briefs

ADDITIONAL
• Volunteer instructor for a free introductory SQL workshop series at a Columbus public library branch
• Speaker at a local data visualization meetup on designing dashboards for executive audiences
